title: Email 1: THE 80% PROBLEM
content:
Subject: Your prospects researched you in ChatGPT this morning

Hey there,

Kris Krug here. Founder of The Upgrade AI. I've spent the last two years training sales professionals—from enterprise teams to solo founders—on how to actually work with AI.

I'm writing because you signed up to learn about AI Upgrade for Sales Leaders. And I want to start with a number that changes everything:

**80%**

That's how much of the buying cycle happens before you know a prospect exists.

They've Googled you. They've asked ChatGPT about your company. They've compared you to competitors. They've prepared questions to ask you based on AI analysis.

THEN they reach out.

By the time you get that email or that call, they've already made most of their decision.

Here's what that means for you:

If you're not producing AI-discoverable content, you don't exist in that 80% phase.

If ChatGPT doesn't know who you are, you're not even in the consideration set.

One of our instructors, Shane Gibson, is now generating over six figures of opportunities from AI-based search. Prospects tell him: "We found you through ChatGPT."

That's not theoretical. That's revenue. This year.

Over the next few days, I'll share exactly how our program transforms sales professionals from AI users to AI builders—from one-off prompting to complete sales systems.

For now, one question:

**What does ChatGPT say about you when your prospects ask?**

If you don't know, we should probably talk.

— Kris

P.S. If you already know you want in, reply "READY" and I'll send the full details.

title: Email 2: THE MULTIPLICATION REALITY
content:
Subject: 53 pieces of content from 30 minutes

Let me show you what multiplication looks like.

Your competitors: Writing one LinkedIn post. Taking 30 minutes. Maybe posting twice a week.

Sales leaders who understand content waterfalls: Creating one 30-minute video. Getting 53 pieces of content. Dominating every channel their buyers use.

- 2 blog posts (different sites, different wording)
- 4 LinkedIn posts (different angles)
- 2 carousels (12 slides each)

From one video.

**Why this matters:**

Your buyers are on 25+ channels daily. LinkedIn. Instagram. TikTok. ChatGPT. Perplexity. Podcasts. YouTube. Slack.

You can't manually create content for all of them. But you can create once and atomize everywhere.

Shane Gibson searches "keynote speaker on AI for sales." He owns 80% of the first page. Not through traditional SEO. Through content atomization.

**Here's the thing most people miss:**

AI determines expertise by volume of quality mentions across the entire internet. Not just your website. Your LinkedIn. Your YouTube. Your podcast appearances. All of it.

The salespeople winning now aren't better at cold calling.

They're better at being found.

Tomorrow I'll explain why our approach is different from every other AI course you've seen.

— Kris

P.S. Still doing prospect research manually? That 30-minute Google-and-wing-it routine? We compress that to 3 minutes with better quality. That's just Week 2.

title: Email 3: SYSTEMS VS. TOOLS
content:
Subject: The difference between users and builders

Let me draw a line.

**Tool users:** Open ChatGPT. Type a prompt. Get output. Copy-paste. Repeat.

**System builders:** Create proposal writers with proprietary knowledge bases. Build content waterfalls that run on autopilot. Deploy AI coaches that analyze every call.

Most AI courses teach the first path. "Here's how to prompt ChatGPT." "Here's how to use Claude." "Here's the latest feature."

That's fine. It's also free on YouTube.

**We teach the second path.**

Here's what that looks like:

**Proposal Writing (Traditional):** 85 minutes finding templates, searching for case studies, customizing, proofreading.

**Proposal Writing (System Builder):** 10-15 minutes. Feed discovery call transcript to Proposal Writer GPT. AI extracts pain points, selects relevant case studies, drafts proposal. Human reviews and refines.

The difference isn't the AI. It's the architecture underneath—the knowledge base, the system prompt, the quality gates.

**Content (Traditional):** Write one LinkedIn post. 30 minutes of staring at blank page. Post. Repeat tomorrow.

**Content (System Builder):** Record one 30-minute video. Content Waterfall Assistant generates 53 pieces. Schedule for the month. Done.

The difference isn't working more. It's building systems that multiply your effort.

**Here's what we actually teach:**

Week 1: Foundations + Expert Optimism (why more knowledge = less fear)
Week 2: Discovery & Coaching (AI-powered call prep and post-call analysis)
Week 3: Proposals & Follow-Up (automated generation, 7-touch sequences)
Week 4: Content Waterfall (53 pieces from one input)
Week 5: CRM Intelligence & Segmentation
Week 6: Capstone Presentations (you ship a real tool)

By Week 6, you have a complete AI-augmented sales system. Not just knowledge. A working toolkit.

Next email: The full curriculum breakdown and what alumni have actually built.

— Kris

P.S. One of our students, Bruce, grew his company from $1M to $20M in a year. When he joined our course, he was building a voice-activated scheduling system to handle the chaos of exponential growth. Zero coding background. Just persistence and AI assistance.
